searchText: b"h — ssh api (geelooy/api/ssh/) the complete awtsmoos ssh api: outbound ssh hosts and an alias backed virtual os, entered through one declarative route vessel. security sensitive: credentials, identity, method, and destructive actions are inspected before use, not after. contents awtsmoos.derech.js — tiny entrypoint: installs buildroutes(...) into the request context. documentation.md — auth, calling cookbook, and family docs pointers. lib/ — route composition root + command, file, shell, and virtual route builders; sftp transfer/removal/file modules; client, callbacks, posix, and shell session machinery. virtual/ — the alias backed virtual world: backend, shell parser, alias store, tokens, permissions, boot lifecycle, service registry, sftp backend. route families command routes — run remote commands behind the security gate. file routes — file/folder/stat/mode/path operations. shell routes — living shell sessions (registry + per session records). virtual routes — the alias backed virtual os and its services. sftp routes — file transfer and removal over sftp. see lib/readme.md and virtual/readme.md.
